rule: The identity detail that follows describes the same person as the face crop, at photographic detail the crop is too small to carry. It settles her skin texture, freckles, brow density, iris colouring and the stray hairs around her part — the things a small crop leaves the render free to invent. It is a likeness reference only: it sets nothing about her pose, her framing, her expression, the garment, the lighting or the background, all of which come from the other images.
